name: Himmelblau: four optima
lesson: Himmelblau has four equally good minima: which one a run finds depends on the seed, and the population then clusters around it.
lookFor: With this seed Run until stop pauses at generation 8, within ε of the optimum at (3, 2). Other seeds end elsewhere: over seeds 1 to 100, 45 runs end at (3, 2), 18 at (−2.81, 3.13), 9 at (−3.78, −3.28) and 28 at (3.58, −1.85). All 100 get within ε.
